title: Saudian Tagine Casserole
description: A flavorful vegetarian casserole inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia, with a rich and aromatic tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add diced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add saudian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add aerated vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Add casserole rice and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the top is lightly browned.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
